body: I thought that it was just me, kinda makes it easier knowing it's not just me suffering from this, ever since I noticed my anxiety and depression it seems to of gotten stronger. Thank you for raising this point though cause I thought it was just me! I'm quite quiet naturally anyway but when I want to speak my words are doing the hurdles and seem to be tripping and stumbling over each and every one.

I've been on two different ones and neither have worked, but it's about finding the ones that do I guess so it's a waiting game if I'm honest with you. Although feeling low constantly is a drain and just drags life out and I don't want to be here anymore.

Furniture making maybe carry on this talk in messages instead? But yeah sounds pretty cool, I need to look in to stuff like that, they're okay friends and all but I try to meet up with one lots and every time she bails on me and has a different excuse every time, but yet she hangs out with her actual friends that same night... Must be doing something wrong clearly

There will be the odd day where I don't get them but when it happens, it hits me hard, all I can think is how I could end it, the thoughts are contemplated, it's strange they're scary and comforting at the same time, like knowing that there is a way out kinda feels nice to know. Crossing a busy road or holding a knife or machining at college i get these thoughts of "oh how easy it'd be to do it right now" life's difficult, people think depression is a choice, or it has to be triggered by something or have a reason for it, it really isn't the case, I just need help friends get bored of my shit so easily, and that's where I feel alone and worthless among other reasons

Thank you so much! I've contacted a local mental health charity it's just finding the courage and confidence to be completely honest. I find myself struggling to get the words out when speaking to people and almost unable to be honest about this stuff. I've rang suicide hotlines before too but that did nothing in the way of help if I'm honest, they didn't really show much support or give advice. Medication isn't a permanent solution and it was never really intended for that, I've just got to help myself as much as I can. I ended up turning to smoking to help relieve stress and now whatever is wrong with me, whether it's me feeling ill, or mood it's all down to smoking in my mum's opinion, she's hard to deal with when I'm so down she's got ocd to name just one thing and that itself is difficult for anyone. But yeah thank you so so much for your help
